678 """Check if estimator adheres to scikit-learn conventions.
679  
680 This function will run an extensive test-suite for input validation,
681 shapes, etc, making sure that the estimator complies with `scikit-learn`
682 conventions as detailed in :ref:`rolling_your_own_estimator`.
683 Additional tests for classifiers, regressors, clustering or transformers
684 will be run if the Estimator class inherits from the corresponding mixin
685 from sklearn.base.
686  
687 scikit-learn also provides a pytest specific decorator,
688 :func:`~sklearn.utils.estimator_checks.parametrize_with_checks`, making it
689 easier to test multiple estimators.
690

1787 def _apply_on_subsets(func, X):
1788 # apply function on the whole set and on mini batches
1789 result_full = func(X)
1790 n_features = X.shape[1]
1791 result_by_batch = [func(batch.reshape(1, n_features)) for batch in X]
1792  
1793 # func can output tuple (e.g. score_samples)
1794 if isinstance(result_full, tuple):
1795 result_full = result_full[0]
1796 result_by_batch = list(map(lambda x: x[0], result_by_batch))
1797  
1798 if sparse.issparse(result_full):
1799 result_full = result_full.toarray()
1800 result_by_batch = [x.toarray() for x in result_by_batch]
1801  
1802 return np.ravel(result_full), np.ravel(result_by_batch)

2833 def check_outlier_corruption(num_outliers, expected_outliers, decision):
2834 # Check for deviation from the precise given contamination level that may
2835 # be due to ties in the anomaly scores.
2836 if num_outliers < expected_outliers:
2837 start = num_outliers
2838 end = expected_outliers + 1
2839 else:
2840 start = expected_outliers
2841 end = num_outliers + 1
2842  
2843 # ensure that all values in the 'critical area' are tied,
2844 # leading to the observed discrepancy between provided
2845 # and actual contamination levels.
2846 sorted_decision = np.sort(decision)
2847 msg = (
2848 "The number of predicted outliers is not equal to the expected "
2849 "number of outliers and this difference is not explained by the "
2850 "number of ties in the decision_function values"
2851 )
2852 assert len(np.unique(sorted_decision[start:end])) == 1, msg
2853

4996 def _output_from_fit_transform(transformer, name, X, df, y):
4997 """Generate output to test `set_output` for different configuration:
4998  
4999 - calling either `fit.transform` or `fit_transform`;
5000 - passing either a dataframe or a numpy array to fit;
5001 - passing either a dataframe or a numpy array to transform.
5002 """
5003 outputs = {}
5004  
5005 # fit then transform case:
5006 cases = [
5007 ("fit.transform/df/df", df, df),
5008 ("fit.transform/df/array", df, X),
5009 ("fit.transform/array/df", X, df),
5010 ("fit.transform/array/array", X, X),
5011 ]
5012 if all(hasattr(transformer, meth) for meth in ["fit", "transform"]):
5013 for (
5014 case,
5015 data_fit,
5016 data_transform,
5017 ) in cases:
5018 transformer.fit(data_fit, y)
5019 if name in CROSS_DECOMPOSITION:
5020 X_trans, _ = transformer.transform(data_transform, y)
5021 else:
5022 X_trans = transformer.transform(data_transform)
5023 outputs[case] = (X_trans, transformer.get_feature_names_out())
5024  
5025 # fit_transform case:
5026 cases = [
5027 ("fit_transform/df", df),
5028 ("fit_transform/array", X),
5029 ]
5030 if hasattr(transformer, "fit_transform"):
5031 for case, data in cases:
5032 if name in CROSS_DECOMPOSITION:
5033 X_trans, _ = transformer.fit_transform(data, y)
5034 else:
5035 X_trans = transformer.fit_transform(data, y)
5036 outputs[case] = (X_trans, transformer.get_feature_names_out())
5037  
5038 return outputs
